records.title: Horse camping
records.supported_claim: Ranch advertises horse camping, potable water for people and horses, and rides/haul-outs.
records.limitations: Owner advertising; no live flow test or exact-rig turning assessment. Route names do not confer public-land permission.

records.title: Paria River Ranch location
records.limitations: Third-party facility reference; not a surveyed gate, hydrant or parking stall.

records.title: Coyote Hollow
records.supported_claim: Four seasonal nonpotable horse-water hydrants may be available; supply can be exhausted late summer/fall. Equestrian camping; fallback water described at Red Canyon Campground.
records.limitations: Campground supply differs from trail water. No present flow or refill capacity verification.

records.title: White House Campground
records.supported_claim: Drinking water is described at Paria Contact Station, not at White House campsites.
records.limitations: Does not establish horse-trailer turnaround, bulk-water fill permission, or current operating hours.

records.title: Backcountry Rides in the Kanab Area
records.supported_claim: Page 1 describes Barracks corrals staging and warns that farther down the road trailer parking/turning is poor; Bay Bill is a riding lead. Page 2 warns about hauling up the Old Paria access grade.
records.limitations: Historical community riding report, not current owner permission or measured rig fit. Do not reuse its broad claims about riding anywhere on BLM land.

records.title: Thunder Mountain trail sheet 33098
records.supported_claim: Indexed USFS description reports narrow exposed terrain, drop-offs and no water on the trail.
records.limitations: Original URL returned HTTP 404 on retrieval; claim retained as a search-index lead needing current manager confirmation. Not field-verified.

records.title: Belly of the Dragon
records.supported_claim: Hiking tunnel reference coordinate and drainage/flash-flood warning.
records.limitations: Hiking attraction, not verified horse passage. Newer tourism location record differs; coordinate is approximate and disputed.

records.title: Utah trailheads
records.supported_claim: Published trailhead reference coordinates, retaining source IDs.
records.limitations: Dataset records here derive from OrbitalView; LastUpdate and access facilities may be null. No evidence of trailer fit.

records.title: Utah roads
records.supported_claim: Road geometry and CARTOCODE including high-clearance code 16.
records.limitations: Road line/class does not establish public passage, current surface, road grade or trailer compatibility.

records.title: Utah trails and pathways
records.supported_claim: Trail geometry and explicit HorseAllowed attributes.
records.limitations: Incomplete network, mixed-source mapping; original observation dates generally unresolved. Does not supersede closures.

records.title: National Forest System trails
records.supported_claim: Trail centerlines, IDs, named segments, tread-width categories and use attributes.
records.limitations: Blank pack/saddle fields are unknown. Tread width is a published category, not a current measurement; typical_trail_grade contains a code, not a numeric grade.

records.title: Utah lidar coverage
records.supported_claim: Completed 2018 Southern Utah and 2019 Kane County projects include sampled locations.
records.limitations: Coverage index is not a terrain raster or present-condition survey; exact per-pixel coverage must be checked.

records.title: USGS Topo
records.supported_claim: Topographic reference context with roads, place names, hydrography and terrain.
records.limitations: Mixed-date compilation; blue streams are mapped hydrography, not verified drinking supplies.

records.title: 3DEP elevation service
records.supported_claim: Bare-earth elevation mosaic used for regional hillshade and slope context.
records.limitations: Resampled service mosaic. Output pixel size does not establish native resolution, acquisition date or vertical accuracy.

records.title: Encouraging your horse to drink
records.supported_claim: Typical 1000-pound horse drinks about 8-10 gallons daily; exercise and heat increase needs.
records.limitations: General husbandry information; five gallons is not a daily upper limit or a sufficient trip-specific allocation.

records.title: Tom Best camping order 0407-21-19
records.supported_claim: Historic order describes restricted roadside camping areas and ends May 15, 2026 by its terms.
records.limitations: Indexed text; original retrieval failed. Expired document is not current permission or closure. Replacement/order search inconclusive.

records.title: Mount Carmel US Topo quadrangle
records.supported_claim: Bay Bill Canyon geographic name and topographic context.
records.limitations: Approximate canyon reference, not a trailhead or recommended turnaround.

records.title: Native 1-meter DEM catalog
records.limitations: Project title does not establish flight date. Bare-earth grid cannot resolve overhangs, unstable footing or guarantee cliff-edge accuracy.

records.title: User destination leads
records.supported_claim: Tom Best Spring Road, Red Mountain and dispersed-camping areas were requested as leads.
records.limitations: Unverified personal planning leads; no current snow report, approved campsite boundary or public permission.
